detected_fault: Laptop hitches and freezes when swapping between APU and GPU modes
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates on the ASUS website
Run a stress test (e.g., Prime95, OCCT) to identify any thermal or power-related issues
Monitor system temperatures and fan performance during GPU-intensive tasks
Consider running a diagnostic tool (e.g., MemTest86+, CrystalDiskInfo) to rule out hardware failures
